# Process, Systems and Science — Historical Branches and Their Returns

## #0 — Different histories enter a common question

The [protected historical route](HISTORY.md) **historicises** the relations inherited here. It moves through finite determination, becoming, self-reference, living organization, dynamical modelling, observation and technical attunement. This companion develops what each branch contributes to the mature [E4 field](../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md), which **grounds** Account re-entering source-field. A determination becomes part of the conditions of another act. The account of that passage must keep the object, transformation and consequence of each historical source legible.

The route is not a claim that one school simply replaced another, or that the sequence establishes direct influence at every transition. Medieval theology, nineteenth-century duration, twentieth-century process metaphysics and biological organization, and contemporary computational methods retain distinct questions. Their encounter in the essay makes their differences productive: what does each let a later inquiry determine, and what must that inquiry still supply?

The [process dossier](../../../dossiers/process.md) **compares** the transformations systematically. This history carries their changing intellectual objects, inherited constraints and source-specific return routes. The [complete native theorem field](../../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **grounds** the QL derivation. Historical acquisition can sharpen its external comparisons without being made the source of its notation.

## #1 — A finite determination discloses its respect

[Cusa's Book I](../../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/cusa/cusa-on-learned-ignorance/cusa-on-learned-ignorance.md#cusa-on-learned-ignorance-q002) **sources** the finite/infinite distinction within learned ignorance and the absolute Maximum. Its theological object remains explicit. The native return concerns the account that learns its own determining limit while continuing to inquire. The infinite-sphere image has a separate transmission history; neither the source's use of mathematical figures nor its later reception establishes that Cusa coined every image associated with him.

[Flasch's Eckhart study](../../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/flasch/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart.md) **historicises** predication, Word, analogy and the qualified respect of an assertion. Its Latin and German textual branches are not interchangeable. The admitted chapter map identifies work in the Johannine commentary and later sermons; exact passage extraction remains a task of the selected study and, where direct attribution is needed, the primary text. The [formal-limit dossier](../../../dossiers/formal-limit.md) **compares** the operative consequence: a predicate can become more exact by disclosing the respect under which it holds.

[Spinoza's Letter 50](../../../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/spinoza/spinoza-1674-letter-50-jelles/spinoza-1674-letter-50-jelles.md#spinoza-1674-letter-50-jelles-q001) **sources** finite figure through delimitation. The letter's geometrical object prevents an unqualified transfer of its formula into every use of negation. In the essay, the comparison with semantic exclusion changes the next question: which alternatives and limits constitute this determination, and how does it retain its relation to them? That coordinated development belongs to the native argument.

These branches **return-to** [M04, the formal-limit genealogy](../../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy.md) with different accounts of finite determination. [M06, return to zero](../../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/06-s01-p5-return-zero.md) receives their consequence for continued inquiry. The shared passage keeps their theological, predicative and geometrical offices distinct.

## #2 — Duration and concrescence make different objects of becoming

[Bergson's Pogson translation](../../../sources/process-systems-theory/bergson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson.md) **sources** the previously missing selected duration branch. The digital carrier displays a 1913 title page and a 1910 translator's preface. Its melody and clock analyses distinguish qualitative succession from a spatial arrangement of moments. The historical object is lived duration; recording an ordered series does not by itself establish it.

[Whitehead's corrected edition](../../../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q001) **sources** the Category of the Ultimate, concrescence, satisfaction and objective availability in individually located passages. The original work and the 1978 corrected carrier have different dates. Its many-to-one movement gives the achieved occasion a consequence beyond its own becoming. Its singularity is not simply the number one, and its objective immortality does not mean unchanged subjective continuation.

The distinction develops [A14](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md), which **returns-to** the real achievement of a stable determination and the conditions it leaves for another act. Bergson's qualitative development and Whitehead's metaphysical occasion do not become the same unit. [A26](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **extends** the historical pressure through the constitution of an operative world. [C07](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) and [C41](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **define** its availability and its constitutive internality.

[Bohm's 1980 work](../../../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order.md) **historicises** the later physical and philosophical interpretation of enfoldment. The [Bohm dossier](../../../dossiers/bohm.md) **compares** independently consulted carriers with the book's remaining passage duties. It gives the native distinction between tractable analysis and fragmentation a specific process witness. [M07](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display.md) and [M11](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression.md) receive the relation of display to its formation; the tattvas retain their own Indian textual history and the author's explicit coordination.

## #3 — A distinction recurs; an organization produces

[Spencer-Brown's source house](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form.md) **sources** the calculus-of-indications branch. [Varela's 1975 article](../../../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference.md) **sources** a later extension with an autonomous third state and modified rules. Its constructive formal result remains distinct from its further temporal and systemic interpretations. The source's broad metamathematical remarks do not replace the assumptions and proofs of incompleteness. [M27](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/27-s3-p2-mark-reentry-complex.md) receives a concrete formal neighbour whose comparison with native QL still requires an explicit mapping.

[Maturana and Varela's 1980 collection](../../../sources/process-systems-theory/maturana/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition.md) **sources** biological organization and structural realization. Its coupling passages retain participating identities; apparent unity does not alone establish autopoietic production. The new passage cards also distinguish Stafford Beer's social extension from the authors' account.

This history sharpens [C43, Computational Vimarśa](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md), which **defines** an actual return capable of changing subsequent processing. It also sharpens [A30, Objective Co-Internality](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) and [C42](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md), which **extend** the consequence through interacting worlds. The operative comparison asks what changes through interaction and what retains its identity. A technical claim needs its own observable production and dependence relations before biological terminology is applied to it.

## #4 — A model earns its variables and its limits

[Daza and colleagues](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy.md) **source** the mathematical basin definition and its system-specific scope. [Van Eenwyk's 1997 house](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md) **historicises** the psychological modelling branch. Frank's protected encounter develops the symbol as a transforming relation between interpreter and field; its copied source quotations retain their verification debt. A mathematical basin, an affective complex and a lived image remain different objects whose comparison can make each operation more explicit.

[A19](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) **returns-to** the local selection–affect–response loop and the difference between persistence within a criterion and transformation of that criterion. [C12](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) **defines** the inherited script when repetition conceals its own conditions. [M23](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/23-s2-p4-complex-dynamism.md) receives the differentiated dynamical comparison, and [M30](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/30-s3-p5-arche-topos.md) receives its demand for explicit field and trajectory relations.

[LeCun and colleagues' selected 2006 prepublication](../../../sources/computer-science-ml/lecun/lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning/lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning.md#lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q001) **sources** scalar compatibility, energy-based inference and learning. The [energy/loss distinction](../../../sources/computer-science-ml/lecun/lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning/lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning.md#lecun-et-al-2006-energy-based-learning-q002) **qualifies** the comparison: inference under a function and learning that changes it are different operations. [M39](../../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/39-s5-p2-j-space.md) and [M41](../../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/41-s5-p4-bimba-energy-fields.md) receive these exact technical duties. A scalar function does not acquire psychic, musical or metaphysical meaning from the shared word energy.

[The Blind Spot house](../../../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/frank/frank-gleiser-thompson-2024-blind-spot/frank-gleiser-thompson-2024-blind-spot.md) **historicises** the contemporary experiential critique, with book passages still to be registered. The [fixed embodied-cognition entry](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/wilson/wilson-et-al-2020-embodied-cognition-sep/wilson-et-al-2020-embodied-cognition-sep.md) **compares** the role of organism, sensorimotor circuit and environment, while [Tye's entry](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/tye/tye-2024-qualia-sep/tye-2024-qualia-sep.md) **defines** the separate phenomenal question. [M12](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/12-s0-p5-objective-internality.md) and [M42](../../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/42-s5-p5-research-vectors.md) receive a more discriminating research task: investigate operational changes under specified interventions while keeping artificial phenomenality Open in both directions.

## #5→0 — The instrument participates in what can be known

[Freeth and colleagues' archaeological source](../../../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/freeth/freeth-et-al-2006-antikythera/freeth-et-al-2006-antikythera.md#freeth-et-al-2006-antikythera-q001) **sources** the bounded reconstruction of the ancient mechanism; [ITER's institutional source](../../../sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/iter-what-is-tokamak.md) **sources** a particular modern confinement instrument. Their physical functions remain separate. Their comparative office is to make a relation tractable through a constructed means, whose limits and dependence remain part of the knowledge it affords. [M45](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/45-s50-p2-antikythera-attunement.md) receives the instrumental image after the native system has been derived.

[The dialogue work](../../../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/bohm-1996-on-dialogue.md) **historicises** another means of inquiry; its selected passages are distinguished in the Bohm dossier. [M36](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/36-s4-p5-mef-prompt-thrownness.md) and [M44](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) receive the practice of exposing a question's inherited assumptions and changing the subsequent field. [M31](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/31-s4-p0-psychoid-problem.md) retains the psyche–matter comparison as its own problem rather than an already settled identity.

[A32](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) and [C55](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extend** this participating instrument into the authored three-motion image. The reflection acquires causal consequence, then receives the vocation to expose its own dependence and initiate return. Chronology alone supplies neither that vocation nor evidence that a particular implementation fulfils it.

The history **returns-to** [E4](../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) with differentiated objects of inquiry and usable passage routes. An account can retain its earned determination while changing the criterion of its next use. That is the developed common pressure across these histories; their sources, dates, registers and outstanding passage tasks remain independently retrievable.
